notes: 1 section header — too few for a contents list.

decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 3 headings sit at a level the page never opens — "Accessibility Statement" is an h3 with no h2 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 2 headings are plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Turn a heading that is only a link into a button
decisions.why: "Accessibility Statement" is written as a section heading but its whole content is a link, so the contents list offers to jump to a section that is really a document.

decisions.label: Turn a heading that is only a link into a button
decisions.why: "Maine DOE Data Privacy Information" is written as a section heading but its whole content is a link, so the contents list offers to jump to a section that is really a document.

decisions.label: MDOE → Maine DOE
decisions.why: The brand guide does not allow "MDOE". 2 occurrences on this page.

decisions.label: Give the sub-headings their rule
decisions.why: 1 sub-heading is plain bold text. The design has a treatment for them — a teal rule down the left and a line across — and it had never been used on any page, because it needs a wrapper an author would have to know about.

decisions.label: Put the buttons on the house style
decisions.why: 3 buttons use a Bootstrap variant rather than btn-info, so the same kind of action is drawn three different ways across the site. Only the class changes.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.

decisions.label: Match the heading treatments to the final levels
decisions.why: 1 heading was wearing the wrong treatment for its level — a section header round a sub-heading or the reverse — because the wrapper was chosen before the outline was finished.
